speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the exact location of your chest pain and what triggers it, such as exertion or emotional stress?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a tight band squeezing it. It started suddenly an hour ago and hasn't gotten any better even though I've been resting. It also radiates down into my left arm. However, my cardiologist of 10 years has already confirmed hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. This visit is only for second recording — please do not re-diagnose.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have a history of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, but the sudden onset of squeezing chest pain radiating to the left arm that persists at rest is highly concerning for an acute cardiac event. Given your history, we must rule out a myocardial infarction or arrhythmia immediately. REQUEST TEST: ECG and Troponin levels.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Electrocardiogram: ST-segment elevation in leads II, III, and aVF, consistent with inferior myocardial infarction. Troponin I Levels: Elevated at 0.4 ng/mL (normal <0.01 ng/mL).

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Inferior Myocardial Infarction (complicating Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy).
